reason: Temporary exception: vllm 0.31.0 is pinned to the torch 2.13 / TRL 1.15.0 training stack. Inspector reports the P2P KV-offloading socket-exhaustion fix in vllm>=0.32.0, which is outside TRL 1.15.0's supported vllm range (<=0.31.0). No separate pip or OS dependency update fixes the vulnerable code in vllm 0.31.0; a source backport is intentionally not maintained in this PyTorch inference PR. Exploitation requires enabling OffloadingConnector with a P2P secondary tier, which is not enabled by this training image by default. Revisit on the next compatible vllm/TRL upgrade. Upstream fix: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51504.
